end.summary:
- Practised sorting objects that roll, slide, or stack.
- Predicted curved objects would roll in 5 of 6 unaided attempts.
- Said books and flat sweets slide rather than roll.
- Believed only balls roll; this remained uncorrected after the last time it appeared.
- Did not yet show that one object can roll on its curved side and stand or stack on its flat side.
end.parentNote: Anika practised noticing curved and flat surfaces to predict whether objects roll or slide. They used the shape of balls, books, laddoo, and barfi to explain their choices, and shared a real example of a laddoo rolling. Anika mixed up the idea that only balls can roll; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, gently test a bottle or glass by placing it on its side and then standing it up, asking what each surface lets it do.
